description: Robinhood Chain KOL coordination / clustering — tokens bought by min_kols+ DISTINCT tracked KOLs inside the window, ranked by KOL count then buy ETH. Per token: buy/sell/net ETH, signal ('accumulating' when net_eth >= 0, else 'distributing'), exited_count vs holders_count, time_to_consensus_sec (first→last KOL buy), MC at first KOL buy, current/peak MC, liquidity, deployer_tier, token age, and the per-KOL breakdown (evm_address, name, twitter_url, buy_eth, sell_eth, exited). Computed read-time from the RHC KOL tape — RHC has no KOL winrate/strategy scores, so those Solana fields are absent. Tier: BASIC.

max_mc_usd.description: Maximum market cap at the first KOL buy — must be >= min_mc_usd

min_kols.description: Minimum distinct KOL buyers for a token to qualify (2-50)

min_mc_usd.description: Minimum market cap at the FIRST KOL buy (tokens with unknown MC are dropped when a band is set)

name: rhc_kol_coordination
